Commentary.Commentary: Sri Lanka have never lost an ODI series to Bangladesh and will aim to not let go of the game from hereon. They have done really well so far but will be aware that the job is not done yet. The Islanders will back their slower bowlers to come good. Bangladesh on the other hand, are on the cusp of something special which should be motivating enough for them to put on a good show. Will the hosts level the series with a win or will Bangladesh script history? Do join us for the chase to find out.

Once Mendis fell it seemed like Sri Lanka may not get too many as the Bangladeshi bowlers bowled some tight overs. Thisara Perera though ensured that the hosts had a good score on board, thanks to his brisk fifty. The skipper Mortaza was the best bowler for the tourists in terms of wickets as he finished with figures of 3/65 in his spell. Mehedi Hasan bowled a tight spell as the rest were economical but not threatening enough.

Top effort from both the sides on what looks like a two-paced deck. Bangladesh won the toss and put Sri Lanka in. They though would not have expected what followed as the hosts raced away to a fine start with a 76-run opening stand. The visitors then came back in the game with a flurry of wickets. Kusal Mendis held one end for his side with a fine half century but did not get enough support from the other end.

Shorter in length outside off, pulled over mid-wicket for a couple of runs. The throw comes in at the striker's end and Lakmal dives in time to get into his crease. So the extra ball does not cost that much. Sri Lanka finish their 50 overs with a score of 280/9!
WIDE! Bowls it slow and very wide outside off, Lakmal looks to throw his bat at it but fails to put bat to ball. That is a wide, how costly will it be?
Suranga Lakmal is the last man in.

OUT! Thisara Perera has to depart! Mortaza bowls it full and outside off, Thisara gets across and looks to paddle it over short fine leg. He does not connect well and Taskin Ahmed stationed there, pouches it safely. End of a brilliant knock by the southpaw.
Slower ball outside off, pushed towards deep point for a single. Smart thing to do, handing the strike back to the set batsman.
Fuller outside off, slammed through mid off for a single.
Nuwan Kulasekara is the new man in.

OUT! Mortaza strikes in time! Full again, Dilruwan looks to go over covers but does not connect well. Tamim Iqbal at extra cover gets under the ball and takes the catch despite a wobble towards the end. A wicket for Bangladesh but the hosts will be happy that Thisara has crossed over and will be on strike for the next ball. With that dismissal, Mortaza now becomes the highest wicket taker in ODIs against Sri Lanka for Bangladesh.
FOUR! Fuller outside off, Dilruwan swings at it and gets it off the outside edge down to third man for a boundary. Good start to the over.
Lands it a touch shorter, Dilruwan drags it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Slants it across around off, Dilruwan swings at it but misses.
Pushes this one through mid off for a single.
Thisara Perera slams his 7th ODI fifty.
Well played, Thisara! Full toss outside off, Thisara skews it over extra cover for a couple of runs. He gets to his fifty, does not happen often but he has contributed well today.
Dilruwan taps it towards short extra cover and takes on the fielder. Had Mosaddek Hossain hit the stumps, Dilruwan would have been out.
Fuller in line of the stumps, Thisara Perera jams it through mid on for a single.
Too full and outside off, hit down to long off for a single.

FOUR! The runs are flowing! Full and wide outside off, Thisara stays in his crease and flays it through extra cover. Mahmudullah stationed in the deep for the particular shot overruns the ball and lets it go through for a boundary.
Fuller again, Dilruwan lofts it down to long on for a single. Even the fielder from long off got there.
Pitched up outside off, Thisara clubs it down to long on for a single.
Shorter outside off, punched hard towards Tamim Iqbal who dives at extra cover and stops a certain boundary. Only a single taken.
Full and wide outside off, hit to sweeper cover for a single.

Slower one outside off, Dilruwan slices it over backward point. Mustafizur Rahman gets to it from third man and stops it. The sweeper cover fielder too reached there in time and hurled the ball back. Two runs taken.
Edged! Full toss outside off, Dilruwan looks to hit it away but gets an edge behind the wickets. Rahim dives to his right to stop it from going through.
WIDE! Slants it on a length but down the leg side. Another wide signaled, the 11th one of the innings.
Shorter around off, pulled hard through mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! Into the stands! Fuller in length, Thisara gets under it and smacks it over the long on fence for a maximum. Sri Lanka are finally getting the big hits. 250 up for the hosts.
Low full toss, slammed through mid on for a couple of runs as Mahmudullah fumbles a touch.

Fuller outside off, Thisara slices it over point and calls for a couple of runs. Sarkar gets to it from the deep and fires a throw at the non-striker's end but misses. Mosaddek Hossain does well to back it up.
Taskin Ahmed comes back on.
FOUR! Smart stuff! Hurls it on a length outside off, Dilruwan gets under it and lofts it over mid off for a boundary. Superb placement there!

Low full toss outside off, Thisara hits it back down the wicket. The ball hits the stumps at the non-striker's end and it deflects towards long off. The umpire too jumped in unison there. Single taken at the end.
Shorter outside off, cuts it over point for a single to get off the mark.
Full outside off, Thisara slams it down to long off for a single.
Fuller outside off, hit towards extra cover.
FOUR! Vital hit! Angles it on the stumps, Thisara gets under it and clobbers it over square leg for a one bounce boundary. Good start to the over.
Shorter outside off, cut to sweeper cover for a single.
Dilruwan Perera is the new man in.

OUT! Mustafizur Rahman strikes! Full and around off, Prasanna looks to go over extra cover. The connection is not good and the ball flies down to Mahmudullah in the deep. He backpedals at wide long off and takes the catch, his third one of the day. The Fizz is happy and the missed run out chance earlier does not cost much.
Beaten! Slower one slanting across off, Prasanna is beaten all ends up.

Just wide! Lands it just around off, Perera looks to work it through the on side but gets a leading edge. The bowler leaps to his right but only gets a fingertip to it. That was a really good effort by the bowler.
FOUR! Two in a row! Low full toss from Rahman, Thisara Perera does not miss out and gets it wide of the diving short fine leg fielder for a boundary.
FOUR! A vital boundary! Too full around off, Perera just presents the full face of the bat and lofts it over the bowler's head for a boundary. Top shot, that!
Another change, Mustafizur Rahman brought back on for a bowl.
Change of gloves for Thisara Perera.
Clipped down to fine leg for a single.

Fuller around the pads, Perera clips it through backward square leg. They take the first one easily but Thisara has to dive to get back in his crease at the striker's end. The skipper is not happy with the fielding effort.

A chance missed! Length ball outside off, Prasanna nudges it towards mid on and takes on the fielder. Mosaddek Hossain gets to it, looks for an underarm throw at the non-striker's end but misses. Prasanna was not even in the frame while the fielder had enough time to run him out getting closer to the stumps. Dean Jones on air reckons that Mosaddek could have even done a Jonty Rhodes there. We will never forget that 1992 World Cup run out of Inzamam-ul-Haq, will we?
WIDE! Shorter in length and it flies over the batsman who ducks under it. A wide is signaled.
Seekkuge Prasanna walks in next.

OUT! The pressure was building and Gunaratne departs! Mortaza bowls one outside off, Gunaratne comes down to have a go at it. The ball goes off the toe end and spoons towards Mahmdullah at mid on who takes it easily going back a touch. The Bangladeshi skipper is elated but Asela is livid with himself for not executing the shot right. He didn't even cross as Thisara was looking to get to the other end.
Slower one outside off, Asela mistimes his punch towards short mid-wicket. This is a good period of play for the visitors.
Starts with a cutter outside off, Gunaratne looks to swing it across the line but is beaten.
Mashrafe Mortaza brings himself back on for a bowl.
Flatter into the pads, worked towards short mid-wicket by Thisara Perera.
Lands it outside off, Gunaratne punches it over covers but only for a run.
Short outside off, Thisara cuts it to deep cover again for a single.
Moves away, gives himself too much room and cuts it to deep covers for a single. Thisara Perera wanted the second but was sent back in time by Gunaratne.
Flatter on the stumps, Thisara comes down the wicket and slams it through mid off for a single.
Asela sweeps one through square leg for a single.
Gunarante looks to force one through the leg side but gets it off the leading edge towards mid off for a single. End of a good spell by Mehedi Hasan, his figures read 10-1-49-1!
Drives it through mid off for a run.
Loops it around off, Thisara comes forward and defends it off the splice of the bat.
Shorter outside off, Asela camps back and cuts it to deep point for a single.
Slowly looped outside off, pushed back to the bowler.
A tad short outside off, punched through covers for a single.
Fires this on the stumps, Gunaratne digs it out back down the wicket. Good over by Mosaddek Hossain.
Short fine leg moves a lot finer.
Lands it on the stumps, worked towards square leg for a run. They think of the second but Mustafizur Rahman is quick to the ball and prevents the second.
Flatter outside off, Gunaratne gets across and clips it through square leg for a single.
Short again but wide enough for Perera to slap it through mid on for a single.

NOT OUT! Good take, Rahim! Shorter in length on the stumps, Thisara Perera looks to pull it away but gets it off the inside edge. The ball lobs off the rebound off something towards the keeper who takes the catch going to his left. The players appeal and it is referred upstairs. The soft signal is not out. Replays show that the ball hit the ground first and then it hit the boot. So Thisara Perera survives!

Bangladesh are optimistic about a catch which was taken by Mushfiqur Rahim. They think they have got their man and the umpire takes it upstairs. The soft signal is not out though. The replays should be interesting.
Fuller outside off, driven through covers for a single.
The umpire signals the start of Powerplay 3. Five fielders are allowed outside the 30-yard circle.
Lands it around middle, Asela gets across and works it through square leg for a run.
Loops it outside off, pushed back towards the bowler who dives to his right and stops it.
Flatter on the pads, Gunaratne tucks it towards the on side.
Shorter around the stumps, punched through mid on for a single.
Too full on the pads, Gunaratne clips it towards square leg for a single.
Works this one towards mid-wicket but not for any runs.
Loops it outside off, Thisara Perera defends it watchfully.
Low full toss on the pads, clipped through square leg for a single. 200 up for SL!
Flatter around off, punched down the wicket.
Lands it on off, Thisara looks to clip it through mid on but gets a leading edge through mid off for a single.
Gunaratne gets across and clips it wide of the short mid-wicket fielder for a single.
Drives it through mid off for a single.
Mosaddek Hossain comes on for a spell.
Gunaratne looks to work this through mid on but gets a leading edge towards mid off. No harm done though.
Full outside off, driven through covers for a single to get off the mark.
Full outside off, pushed into covers. Gunaratne wants the single but Thisara doesn't. Fortunately for Sri Lanka, Gunaratne gets back in his crease in time.
Shorter outside off, worked towards short mid-wicket by Thisara.
Lands it around off, Thisara defends it watchfully.
Fuller outside off, driven through mid on for a single.
Mehedi Hasan returns for a bowl.
Thisara Perera walks in next.

OUT! Once beaten, twice shy and third time gone! The angle was troubling Mendis and he perishes to that dab shot. Another one which is slanted around off, Mendis looks to run it down but this time he is not as lucky as he was on the previous two occasions. He gets an outside edge which carries to the keeper Rahim who takes it easily. The difference this time was that it was bowled a lot quicker. End of a fine knock by Kusal Mendis but he was beginning to get tired and it seemed like the heat was getting to him, so the hosts might not mind the wicket.
Bowls it on the stumps, Mendis tucks it towards short mid-wicket. That was another cutter from Rahman.
Slants it outside off, Mendis looks to dab it down but misses it yet again.
Slower in pace, fuller in length, Asela controls his drive through covers for a single.
Goes round the wicket. There is a point in place now and no mid-wicket.
Lands it short on the stumps, tucked towards backward square leg for a single. Mendis was kneeling down and struggling with fitness it seems.
Slants it on a length outside off, Mendis looks to dab it down but misses.

FOUR! Good shot! Full outside off, Gunaratne drives it sweetly through covers. Sarkar in the deep, tries to cut it off going to his right but the timing is too good and Asela gets a boundary. Good end to the over for the hosts.
Shorter in length outside off, Mendis flays it over backward point and Mustafizur Rahman gets across from deep third man to keep them to a single.
Slower and fuller one on the stumps, worked towards short mid-wicket but not for any run.
Short again, Asela gets across and dabs it to third man for another single.
Banged in short outside off, Mendis rides the bounce and taps it to third man for a single.
Shorter in length outside off, cut to deep point for a single.
Goes back to over the wicket to Mendis, slants it on the stumps, Mendis works it towards mid-wicket.
Tries to get one to jag back in but bowls it on the stumps, Asela gets across and clips it towards short mid-wicket for a quick single.
The change almost works! Lands it outside off on a length, Gunaratne pokes at it from his crease and is beaten. Replays show that went away at the last moment.
Goes round the wicket.
FOUR! Top, top shot! Full outside off, Gunaratne waits for it and guides it ever so nicely past the fielder at backward point for a boundary.
Shorter outside off, Gunaratne mistimes his punch towards covers.
A tad short outside off, pulled towards short mid-wicket where the fielder fumbles and parries it towards mid on. A single taken in the end.
Mustafizur Rahman called back on for a burst.
Kusal Mendis brings up his 9th ODI fifty.
Well played, Kusal Mendis! On a length just around off, Mendis works it through square leg for a single. That also brings up his fifty. He will know his job is not done yet and has to carry on.
Gunaratne gets a long way across and tucks this one through backward square leg for a single.
Lands it outside off on a length, Asela is not sure and has a waft at it. He is beaten all ends up and then practices the punch that he should have played.
Shorter around off, dabbed towards short third man.
Fuller outside off, driven towards point by Gunaratne.

Taskin Ahmed has slipped in his run-up and falls over on the pitch. His teammates get around to ask if he is okay and Taskin nods in the affirmative. Replays show his back leg didn't land well after the jump and hence he slipped.
Shorter outside off, Mendis guides it down to third man for a single. Rahim is not happy with the effort of Mustafizur Rahman at deep third man, not sure why as it was only a single.
Taskin Ahmed called back on for a bowl. Strangely, he was limping in the previous over but is now ready to bowl.
Mendis lunges across and clips it through mid-wicket for a run.
Flatter around off, Mendis punches it in the air towards wide of mid on. There is no mid on though and the bowler goes across to stop it.
Lands it on middle, driven down to long on for a single by Gunaratne.
Clips this through mid-wicket for a run.
Pushed towards mid on for a single.
Taskin Ahmed has hurt himself and is struggling.

FOUR! Poor stuff! Lands it around the stumps, Gunaratne gets across and paddles it down to fine leg. Rahim anticipates it but cannot stop it. Taskin Ahmed in the deep looks to cut it off but rolls over and fails to stop the ball. He seems to have hurt himself in the process.
Drives it through mid on for a single.
Fuller on middle, worked towards short mid-wicket.
Gunaratne looks to drive this one but gets an inside edge towards mid on.
Nudges one towards the leg side for a single.

Good stop, Mosaddek Hossain! Shorter on the stumps, Mendis crouches low and sweeps it in front of square on the leg side. Hossain runs across from deep mid-wicket, dives and stops the ball from going through. Two runs taken.
Fuller around off, Asela comes down and drives it through covers for a single.
Gets off the mark with a drive to mid on for a run.
Gunaratne gets in line of this flighted delivery and defends it watchfully.
Flatter on the stumps, Asela defends it towards mid-wicket.
Asela Gunaratne is the new man in.

OUT! Brilliant work, Rahim! Shorter in length just around the stumps, Siriwardana punches it towards point and takes off for a single. Shuvagata Hom, the substitute stationed there, gets to the ball and fires it at the striker's end. Siriwardana is sent back and he lunges to get back into his crease. Rahim takes the bails off behind him and appeals. The umpire refers it upstairs but the Bangladesh fielders are celebrating already. Replays show why - the throw was a wide one but Rahim did extremely well to get it onto the stumps in a flash. Siriwardana is way short of his crease and has to depart.
Shorter in length, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
Milinda drives it through mid off for a single.
Flicks one through the on side for a run.
FOUR! Top shot! Shakib fires it on leg, Siriwardana opens himself up and lofts it down the ground coming down the wicket. The ball races away to the fence.
Works one through mid-wicket for a single.
Spots the batsman coming down and fires it on the pads, Milinda punches it through mid on for a single.
Floats it around off, Mendis looks to clip it but gets it off the inner half through backward square leg. Shakib has his hands on his head as he sits down knowing that was really close.
Flatter outside off, whipped through mid-wicket for a single.
Time for a drink.
Mendis flicks this fuller delivery towards mid-wicket.
Siriwardana drives this tossed up delivery through covers for a single. 150 comes up for Sri Lanka.
Mendis flicks this through mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up, outside off, Siriwardana gives himself room and looks to go over covers but Mehedi follows him and ball catches a thick inside edge and goes towards long on. Single taken.
Shortish and spinning in, Mendis works it through square leg for a single.

FOUR! Mendis welcomes Mehedi Hasan back with a boundary. The bowler bowls this full and around off, Mendis kneels and sweeps it powerfully in front of square for a boundary. There were two deep fielders present but it beats them both.
Mehedi Hasan is back on.
Sprays this on the pads, Siriwardana looks to nudge it away but it hits his pad and goes towards the leg side.
Fuller again and around off, Siriwardana bunts it back to the bowler.
Full and on the sticks, defended carefully.
Milinda dances down the track and flicks this fullish delivery to mid-wicket.
Short and around leg, Mendis tucks it through backward square leg. Single taken.
Siriwardana tucks it through backward square leg for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Mendis flicks this length ball through mid-wicket for a brace. The deep fielder was a bit slow there and could've done better. Mortaza lets him know about the same.
Short of a length delivery, outside off, Siriwardana cuts it through point for a single.
Siriwardana punches this length delivery towards covers.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Mendis dabs it to third man for a single.
On a length and around off, Mendis nudges it to the on side.
Siriwardana tucks this delivery towards the leg side.
Milinda Siriwardana is the new man in.

OUT! What has happened here? Silly this from Chandimal, schoolboy cricket really. Shakib tosses this outside off, Chandimal drives it towards covers and starts running. It looks like an easy two. Taskin Ahmed from the deep hurls a throw to Rahim who flicks the bails off and appeals. Chandimal looks to have just plonked his bat getting into his crease. The umpire has referred it upstairs. Now to the replays, it looks like a tricky one. While Chandimal was inside the crease he had failed to drag his bat and even his feet were in the air. The third umpire looks at the replays for quite a while before concluding that Dinesh Chandimal is indeed out. The Bangladeshis cannot believe their luck and they are celebrating. Dinesh Chandimal should be very upset with his effort there.
Another run out appeal is referred upstairs. Looks like Chandimal has plonked his bat in the crease at the striker's end. That looks close!
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Mendis flicks this through mid-wicket for a single.

Not out! The running between the wickets has been stupendous today! Floats this one around off, Mendis sweeps it through mid-wicket and sets off. Seeing that the deep fielder is a bit slow he urges Chandimal to come for the second and the former does. The deep fielder hurls a throw at the non striker's end and Shakib disturbs the bails. He appeals and the umpire takes it upstairs. Replays suggest that Chandimal had made his ground easily. Interesting point from the commentators on air - they say that Chandimal should run in a straight line. He was running across and that could've resulted in a run out.
There is a run out appeal at the non-striker's end and it is referred upstairs. Doesn't look out, that.
Tosses this one outside off, Mendis waits for it and cuts it through covers for a single.
Shakib Al Hasan returns for a bowl.

Excellent running! On a fuller length and slightly outside off, Chandimal looks to push it away but it goes off the inside edge and hits him on the pads. Mendis starts running and Chandimal responds. They complete the run quite easily in the end.
Bowls this full and keeps it on the fourth stump line, Chandimal defends it.
Full and on the pads, Mendis clips it uppishly to fine leg for a single.
Good length delivery, outside off, Dinesh drives it to mid off and runs a single.
On a length and around middle, Chandimal clips it to mid-wicket.
Full and on the sticks, Dinesh is rock solid in defense.
Good length delivery, around middle and leg, Chandimal flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Sticks to the fuller length and keeps it on the sticks, blocked.
Fullish and outside off, Dinesh taps it towards point.
Bowls this full and on the pads, Mendis whips it through mid-wicket. Single taken.
Full and around off, Dinesh cuts it very late through third man for a single.
Dean Jones on air mentions an interesting fact about Kusal Mendis. The Sri Lankan no. 3 has a very good record against left-arm bowlers in ODIs, averaging over 80.
Marginally ahead of a length and in the line of the stumps, Chandimal pushes it towards point.
Short of a length and around off, Chandimal hops a bit and blocks it towards the off side. He asks Mendis to come for the run and the latter responds. Brilliant running this!
Wide! Strays this on the pads, Dinesh misses his clip. Mortaza will have to bowl that one again.
Lands this on a length and outside off, Mendis dabs it to third man for a single.
Good length and outside off, Dinesh taps it through backward point for a single.

On a length, slower ball, Mendis pushes it on the up towards mid off and sets off. The mid off fielder goes to his left and hurls a throw at the striker's end but misses. It wouldn't have mattered even if he had hit as Chandimal had made his ground.
Angles a full ball, around off, Mendis pats it back to the bowler.
Fuller and outside off, Mendis gets forward and pushes it towards mid off.
Mashrafe Mortaza comes back for a bowl.
Changes the pace on the last ball, bowls it at 115 kph and outside off, Chandimal doesn't read it and gets beaten.
Fuller again and on off, Dinesh drives it to mid off.
Bowls this on the pads, Sri Lanka's no. 3 nudges it to fine leg for a single.
The square leg fielder is asked to go in the deep.
Fuller again and on middle, Mendis strides forward and pats it to point. Good start to the over!
Fullish delivery and outside off, Kusal covers his stumps and leaves it alone.
Back of a length delivery, outside off, Mendis looks to pull but is late on it. The ball takes the inside edge and goes towards the bowler.
Mendis works this looped up delivery towards short fine leg and takes a single.
Mendis pushes this floated delivery towards covers.
Chandimal uses his feet and eases this tossed up delivery through mid off for a run.
Mendis flicks this through mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Very cheeky this from Mendis. Tossed up delivery outside off, Mendis waits for the ball, opens the face of the bat and just places it past the keeper. The short third man fielder, Mosaddek Hossain Saikat, gives it a chase but fails to stop it. A boundary results.
Short and outside off, Mendis goes back and cuts it towards covers, where Mehedi makes a sharp stop to his right.
On a length and outside off, Mendis looks to drive but it goes off the outer half of the bat to third man. Single taken.
Very full and outside off, Dinesh carves this through covers for a single.
Serves a slower leg cutter, outside off, Chandimal picks it up early and blocks it.
Fullish delivery and outside off, Dinesh drives this beautifully but straight to the cover fielder.
Bowls this full again and around off, Chandimal mistimes his drive towards mid off.
Fuller and around off, Chandimal is rock solid in defense.
Mustafizur Rahman comes back for a bowl.
Flights this one around middle, clipped towards the on side. Expensive over this, 9 from it!
Tosses this one outside off, Mendis pushes it towards covers.
The slip has come out and is now standing at short mid-wicket.
Mendis bunts this back to the bowler.
FOUR! And another, consecutive boundaries for Mendis. Shakib bowls this short and outside off, Kusal Mendis goes back and pulls it to the deep mid-wicket fence for a boundary.
FOUR! Neatly done! Full and on the sticks, Mendis kneels and sweeps it through square leg for a boundary.

Run out chance missed! Shakib pitches this full, Chandimal goes forward and pushes it towards covers and sets off. Mehedi Hasan stationed there collects it by running forward and hurls a throw at the keeper's end. The ball was too wide for Rahim to whip the bails off. The batsmen complete the single. Had Mehedi hit the stumps, Mendis would've been a goner.
Length ball, outside off, punched towards the off side.
On a length and outside off, Mendis is in two minds, whether to defend or leave it alone. He looks to pull out of the shot at the very last moment but is beaten.
Another heated discussion between Iqbal and Mortaza.
Short of a length around leg, Mendis looks to tuck but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Iqbal is having a word with Taskin. He is not happy with the lines he has bowled.

Two Wides! Taskin is under pressure. Bowls this down the leg side again, Chandimal misses his flick and Rahim fails to gather it. The ball rolls to fine leg as they take a single. 100 up for Sri Lanka.
Full and on the stumps, blocked.

FOUR! Poor delivery really. Sprays this down the leg side, Chandimal waits in his crease and flicks it through square leg for a boundary. A bit of an animated chat between Tamim Iqbal and Mashrafe Mortaza. The former is not happy with some field changes and conveys the same to his captain.
FOUR! Beautifully timed. Taskin Ahmed bowls this full and outside off, Chandimal gets forward and drives it through covers for a boundary. Awesome stroke, that.
Shortish again on leg, Mendis tucks it towards backward square leg and looks for a single. Chandimal is not interested and sends him back.
Shakib bowls this on the stumps, Mendis leans forward to bury it.
Sprays this around leg, Chandimal goes back a bit and whips it through mid-wicket. One run added to the total.
Shortish and around off, Mendis uses the depth of the crease and nudges it in front of square on the leg side. Single taken.
Floats this one outside off, Dinesh gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it through covers for a single.
Tossed up delivery outside off, turns a bit, Chandimal cuts it to covers.
Full and around off, Kusal Mendis has defended it solidly. A maiden over! Brilliant this from Taskin Ahmed.
On a length which comes back in, Mendis blocks it from his crease.
Short of a length ball outside off, Mendis gets on top of the ball and cuts it to point.
On a length and outside off, Kusal gets on his feet and drives it towards point.
Swing and a miss! Marginally ahead of a length and outside off, Mendis looks to drive but is nowhere near the ball. Narrowly missed the outside edge!
Taskin hurls a back of a length delivery around middle, Mendis stands in his crease and defends it towards the leg side.
Two slips in place now for Taskin Ahmed.
Bowls this on the stumps, flicked towards mid-wicket.
Chandimal taps this looped up delivery towards point.
Flights this one outside off, Chandimal looks to block but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Shortish around middle and leg, Mendis tucks it towards backward square leg for a single.
Floats this one outside off, Kusal defends it towards the off side.
Tosses this one outside off, Mendis looks to cut it away from his body but gets an inside edge which goes towards the slip fielder.
Shakib Al Hasan comes into the attack. A slip in place for him.
Bowls this on a fuller length and gets it to nip back in, Dinesh prods forward in defense.
On a length and outside off, Chandimal has left it alone.
Dinesh Chandimal is the new man in.
Time for a drinks break!

OUT! Bowled neck and crop! Hurls it just around off on a length, comes in late, Tharanga does not read the line well and is beaten all ends up. The ball goes through the gap between his bat and pad to hit the timber. That was well set up by Taskin as he kept bowling short to push Tharanga back and then bowled it a touch fuller targeting the stumps. A wicket earned by the bowler. The umpire asks Tharanga to wait as they check for the no ball but the replays show that the landing was fine there and the Sri Lankan skipper has to walk back. Timely strike for Bangladesh.
WIDE! Shorter in length on the stumps, Tharanga lets it go over him. It is way too short and a wide is signaled.
Leading edge! Taskin hurls it around off, Mendis looks to clip it through the leg side but gets a leading edge towards covers for a single. Kusal closed the face of the bat early there.
Full outside off, Mendis defends it towards mid off.
Shorter in length just around off, shapes in, Tharanga plays down the wrong line at first as he expected it to go away. He adjusts in time to chop it down to third man for a single.
Flatter around off, Mendis kneels down to sweep but fails to connect cleanly and gets an inside edge.
Short again outside off, punched wide of extra cover for a couple of runs.
Shorter on middle, Tharanga goes back and punches it through covers for a single.
Defends this one watchfully from his crease.
Loops this one on middle, Mendis crouches low and sweeps it through backward square leg for a single.
Floats it outside off, Tharanga drives it through covers for a single.

Roshan Abeysinghe and Shamim Chowdhury on air mention about Sri Lanka's performance in the Powerplay in the first ODI. They had lost two wickets and scored only 30 runs. But today, they have attacked more and scored 76 runs without losing any wicket. That shows their intent.
Shorter outside off, Mendis guides it towards point from his crease.
Full outside off, Mendis drives it nicely to mid off.
A touch short around off, Tharanga punches it through covers for a single.
Shorter in length, angling away, Tharanga arches back and lets it go.
Slants it on the pads, Mendis works it down to fine leg for a single.

Needless! Shorter in length on middle, Tharanga punches it towards extra cover from his crease. Sabbir Rahman stationed there, comes across to his left and looks to flick it towards the stumps at the non-striker's end. He fumbles and the ball goes wide of the stumps. They take an overthrow. The bowler is unhappy with that cheeky and unnecessary effort.
Taskin Ahmed returns for a bowl.
Lands it outside off, Mendis comes forward and defends it. WICKET MAIDEN for Mehedi Hasan!
Kusal Mendis is the new man in. He scored a century in the previous encounter and will want to carry his good work forward.

OUT! What a soft dismissal! Mehedi floats it outside off, Gunathilaka looks to drive it on the up but is early into the shot. The ball lobs towards extra cover where Mahmdullah takes it easily. Finally a wicket for the visitors and the dangerous-looking opening stand is broken. Gunathilaka was struggling to read Mehedi Hasan today and has paid the price for it.
Goes back in his crease to cut but mistimes it towards covers.
Shorter in line of the stumps, Gunathilaka stays back and punches it towards covers.
Lands it around off, pushed back to Mehedi by Gunathilaka.
Floats it around off, driven back to the bowler.
There is a slight drizzle in the air.
Powerplay 2 has been signalled. Maximum of four fielders are allowed outside the circle now till the end of the 40th over.
Flatter on middle, Gunathilaka comes across and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter outside off, Upul nudges it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Fires it on the pads, Tharanga looks to clip it through but gets hit on his body.
Flatter on middle and leg, Danushka clips it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Edged! Lands it on middle, Tharanga looks to defend but gets an outside edge towards short third man for a single.
Flatter on the pads, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Another bowling change, Mahmdullah comes on for a bowl. Taskin Ahmed goes off the field.
Danushka goes back and tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single. Expensive over for Bangladesh, 10 runs from it.
FOUR! The runs are flowing! Mehedi lands it around off, Gunathilaka kneels down and sweeps it over backward square leg for a boundary.
FOUR! Up and over! Gunathilaka gets under this fuller length ball on the stumps and lofts it over the leaping mid on fielder for a boundary.
Floated on the stumps, Gunathilaka defends it with an inside edge onto his pads.
Pushes this one towards covers off his crease.

Almost a run out! Gunathilaka defends this one towards point. They think of a single. Taskin Ahmed from backward point gets to the ball and throws it at the bowler's end. But he hurls it very high. Mehedi jumps and looks to deflect it back onto the stumps but misses. That would have been close.
WIDE! Slants it down the leg side. Another wide.
Hurls it around off, Tharanga looks to drive but gets an inside edge onto his pads. That was close. End of a really long over by Taskin Ahmed.

Good stop! Lands it outside off, Gunathilaka angles it towards gully. Mehedi the fielder leaps up to stop it and has a shy at the striker's end. He misses and there is an overthrow but the Bangladesh skipper is happy with the effort. A single taken at the end.
Goes round the wicket.
Slants it on a fuller length around the pads, Gunathilaka clips it over mid-wicket for a brace. This has been a long over for Taskin and he has sprayed the ball around.
Lands it around off, Gunathilaka looks to go over mid on but gets an inside edge onto his back leg.
WIDE! Another one down the leg side on a good length, Gunathilaka lets it go. Wide signaled.

Slants it on the pads, Tharanga fails to clip it cleanly. He gets it off the pads and Rahim gets a hand to it diving to his right. The ball almost hits the helmet stationed behind the keeper. Would have been five penalty runs. Wayward start, this.
Beaten! Hurls it around off and middle, Tharanga has to play at it. The ball jags away at the last moment to beat the outside edge.

Five Wides! Starts with a shorter length ball but is way down the leg side. Rahim does not get to it despite the dive to his right. The ball runs into the fine leg fence. Wides signaled and Taskin Ahmed has started like his captain, with the wrong line.
Double change. Taskin Ahmed replaces Mustafizur Rahman.

SIX! That was always coming! Gunathilaka was struggling to pick Mehedi and this time he has taken the aerial route. This one is bowled around off and middle, the southpaw kneels down and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket for a maximum.
Danushka comes forward to defend but spots that is short and he goes back to defend it in a hurry.
Shorter around off, Gunathilaka is not reading it but does well to keep it out towards mid on.
Lands it just around off, Danushka defends it towards point off the outer half of the bat.
Another one in the area of uncertainty, defended watchfully.
Floats it just around off, Gunathilaka comes forward to defend but is beaten all ends up.
Mehedi Hasan comes into the attack. The Sri Lankans are cruising and Bangladesh desperately need a wicket. Can the spinner provide that?
Fuller outside off, Tharanga comes forward and drives it sweetly to point.

FOUR! Catch that! Shorter outside off, Tharanga looks to pull at first but then just flashes it hard through backward point. The ball races away to the fence in no time. Tamim Iqbal from mid on, comes over to have a chat with the bowler.
Slower one, just outside off, Tharanga lunges forward and works it towards the leg side.
FOUR! Tharanga is putting on an exhibition here! Full just around off, Tharanga just lofts it over mid off for a majestic boundary. He is really timing them superbly today.
FOUR! Tonked! Shorter outside off, Tharanga gets on top of it, rolls his wrists over it and gets it through wide mid on for a boundary. He read the length quickly there.
WIDE! Sprays this one wide outside off, Tharanga cannot reach to it. A wide is signaled.
Dabs this one down to third man for a single.
SIX! Going, going, gone! Mortaza bowls a back of a length delivery, outside off, Tharanga does not miss out as he swivels and dispatches this over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum. Superb shot.
Gunathilaka opens the face of the bat and gets it towards short third man for a quick single.
Taps this one towards point from his crease.

Did it carry? Nope! Hurls it outside off, Gunathilaka loses his balance as he looks to defend it from his crease. He gets an outside edge which just dips on Rahim. He takes it on the bounce. That was really close, Mortaza has dismissed him before in the series and it almost worked yet again. Had he got out, he would have rued not taking the second run on the previous ball.
Lands it in line of the stumps, nudged towards long leg for a single. There was a hint of confusion as Tharanga wanted the second but not Gunathilaka. The SL skipper is not happy.
Lands it outside off, worked towards square leg for a single.
Beaten! Shorter outside off, comes in with the angle, Tharanga arches back to cut it through but does not get bat to it.

Loud shout for an lbw, not given though! Fuller in length on the stumps, Tharanga looks to clip it away but misses and is hit on his pads. There is a loud appeal for an lbw but nothing from the umpire. They think of a review but do not go for it as it always looked to be sliding down leg. Interestingly, Mortaza was going at the other end to get ready to bowl, thinking it was over but we still have a ball left.
Back of a length on the stumps, Tharanga tucks it towards square leg off his crease.
Tharanga comes forward and taps this one towards point.
Good length just around off, Tharanga plays at it from his crease and is beaten.
Fuller outside off, Gunathilaka clips it through mid-wicket. The fielder gets to it in time and stops it from going to the fence. Three runs taken.

Fumble but no harm done! On a length outside off, Tharanga taps it towards deep third man. The backward point fielder gives it a chase but fumbles and fails to stop it and Taskin Ahmed, at third man, eventually collects it. Seeing that misfield, the batsmen look for a second but settle for a run. Mashrafe Mortaza is not impressed one bit with that effort and asks his fielders to be more aware.
Slanting on the pads, Tharanga looks to put it away but fails to connect. The ball lobs off the pads for a leg bye towards square leg.
Tharanga stays back and punches it towards Mehedi Hasan at covers who stops it.
Tucks one towards mid-wicket for a single.

A couple of chances there! Fuller around off, Gunathilaka drives it hard down the wicket. The bowler, Mortaza gets both his hands to it but cannot hold onto it. It almost gets parried to mid on. Tamim Iqbal stationed there, runs to his right and but does not get to it. In the last game, Taskin Ahmed had taken a catch on the rebound off his own bowling. Luckily for Gunathilaka, the ball did not carry to the fielder today.
Goes round the wicket, bowls it around off, Gunathilaka defends it watchfully.
FOUR! Oh my, what a shot! Full around off, Tharanga just stands tall and drives it with sublime timing past extra cover for a boundary. Brilliant start for him.

Slants it on middle and leg, Tharanga looks to help it on its way but seems to have missed it. The keeper Rahim goes to his right and collects it. The players go up in an appeal but the umpire stays put. Rightly so, as there was no bat there as it went off the thigh pad and the Bangladesh skipper confirms the same by having a word with the umpire.
Length ball just around off, Tharanga comes forward and defends it into covers.
Full again outside off, Tharanga mistimes his drive towards covers.
FOUR! Pristine timing! Fuller outside off, Tharanga gets a tad forward and creams it through covers for a boundary. Superb timing on that occasion.
Hurls it outside off on a length, left alone.
Mustafizur Rahman to bowl from the other end with the second new ball.
Lands it outside off, Gunathilaka comes forward and defends it.
There is a deep square leg in place now.
FOUR! Nicely done! Mortaza slants it on the pads, Gunathilaka does not miss out and clips it through square leg for a boundary.
Gunathilaka stays in his crease and defends it.
Fuller in length just around off, driven nicely towards mid on.
Lands it on a length on the stumps, Tharanga tucks it towards backward square leg. There is a slight misfield by Mahmudullah but no harm done.
Edged! Mortaza gets this one right, bowls it around off, Gunathilaka looks to defend but gets an outside edge through point for a single.
WIDE! And another one swinging down the leg side, another clip missed. Wide signaled again!
WIDE! Starts with a length ball down the leg side, Gunathilaka can't clip it away.
The players are out in the middle. The two Sri Lankan openers Upul Tharanga and Danushka Gunathilaka are out to bat. Bangladesh begin with Mashrafe Mortaza! Here we go...

Sri Lanka skipper, Upul Tharanga says that even they would have bowled first. States that there is grass on the wicket but it is dry underneath. Opines that SSC is a good batting wicket. Conveys that Kusal Mendis fought very hard in the last match which helped them post a good total. Thinks that there is not too much pressure on them, last game unfortunately got washed out. Feels that it got darker earlier in the last few days but adds that weather is something they can't control.

Bangladesh skipper, Mashrafe Mortaza begins by saying that rain has been a factor in their decision to bowl first. Is hopeful that the grass will help the seamers. Calls it a 250-270 wicket. On the pressure of winning, he opines that pressure is a good thing and it helps them perform. Adds that Sri Lanka batted well on the flat deck in the previous game and they would have also loved to bat first.
Toss - Bangladesh win the toss and opt to field! They are unchanged from the previous game. Sri Lanka make a solitary change - Seekkuge Prasanna comes in for Nuwan Pradeep.

Pitch report - Russel Arnold doing the pitch report reckons that it is a belter of a wicket. There is a lot more grass on the deck which should help the seamers early in the day. He also adds that spinners will come into play later in the day. Opines that he would look to bowl first with the conditions on offer. Jokes about the par score being 350.

The visitors are in a position they are not quite accustomed to - leading the series 1-0 going into the final game. They have never won a bilateral ODI series against the Islanders and this could be their best chance. The last ODI played at this very ground was way back in 2011, so it remains to be seen how the deck behaves. There is a lot at stake, so expect a cracker!

Hello everyone and welcome to the coverage of the third and final ODI between Sri Lanka and Bangladesh at the Sinhalese Sports Club, Colombo. The hosts posted a challenging score on board in the second encounter and would have been confident of defending it before rain played spoilsport. Upul Tharanga and co. will have to put it behind them and regroup quickly.
